ruling.recommended_action: Refund $3.74 to the rider as a Ryde voucher for the two unexempted off-route segments on this RydeTAXI metered trip, and record the RD-1 breach against the driver on the trip file; no account flag.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment 22:57–23:03 adding 1.14 km with no traffic incident on the replaced optimal stretch [F13], so RD-4(a) fails; the only speed record is band 3, which cannot exempt a segment on its own [F11][RD-4]; no prior driver route proposal and rider agreement [F8][F9][F10][RD-5]; no rider-requested stop [RD-3].

Off-route segment 23:21–23:24 adding 1.51 km with no traffic incident on the replaced optimal stretch [F13], so RD-4(a) fails; band 3 speed records do not suffice [F12][RD-4]; no prior driver route proposal and rider agreement [F8][F9][F10][RD-5]; no rider-requested stop [RD-3].

rejected_claims.reason: The rider computes 2.65 × $1.41 = $3.74 using the stated $1.41/km rate [F5], but that rate rounds to $3.74 only via the higher derived rate; the trace formula ($35.17 ÷ 24.9 km = $1.4124) gives 2.65 × $1.4124 = $3.7429 → $3.74 [F3][F4][F7][RD-2]. The claim's stated arithmetic is imprecise even though its total is adopted.

The rider treats the full 3.1 km excess ($4.41 billed) as recoverable [F1][F5], but RD-2 refunds only the unexempted segment kilometres; the ~0.45 km residue between the total gap and F3+F4 is map-matching residue and is excluded [F1][F3][F4][RD-2].
The driver computes 2.65 × $1.41 = $3.73 [F5], but the governing rate is the fare-derived $1.4124/km, giving $3.7429 → $3.74 [F3][F4][F7][RD-2]. Truncating to $3.73 understates the refund.

The driver characterises most of the excess as residing in the segments but frames the deviation claim narrowly; the segments are unexempted and RD-1 is breached on the full 2.65 km of F3+F4 [F3][F4][F13][RD-1].

The driver offers RD-4 as failing, which is correct, but the underlying justification in F10 ('I followed my GPS') would still need a traffic fact on the replaced stretch to be a reasonable cause, and none exists [F10][F11][F12][F13][RD-4].

The driver asserts waiting time is untouched under RD-3(c) [F7]; correct as far as it goes but irrelevant, since the refund is a distance-unit refund under RD-2, not a waiver of any stop or waiting charge [RD-2][RD-3].
